Distribution. Endemic to Lebanon. It was found in clearings of oak (1.000 – 1.400 m a. s. l.) and cedar woods (1.400 – 1.800 m a. s. l.) on the western slopes of the Mount Lebanon chain, and semi-arid steppes on the eastern slopes of the same mountain chain (1.400 m a. s. l.). It was also found on the peak of the Anti-Lebanon mountain chain near the Syrian border in the Oro-Mediterranean steppe (1.900 m a. s. l.). The lower altitudes were not heavily sampled, and the species could well have a larger distribution than reported (Fig. 2).
